resources.string: Allow “Display over other apps” for this app, then start the overlay.
Allow “All files access” so the overlay can edit phone saves and restart the game.

For a normal (non-root) phone: grant overlay + all-files access, start the overlay, open Tuber Simulator, tap the red bubble, set values, then tap APPLY & RESTART GAME. That patches any editable Android/data saves and relaunches the game — no BlueStacks needed.
